newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Amalgamated says 1st qtr profit down.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Amalgamated says 1st qtr profit down.

text.p: Hotel cinema and leisure group Amalgamated Holdings ltd said on Thursday that operating profit in the three months to September 30 had fallen to A$15.7 million from A$17.0 million a year ago.

Chairman Alan Rydge told shareholders that the cinema and Australian ski resort operations were behind budget and profit compared with last year, while the Rydges hotel group was behind budget but its profit was slightly ahead of last year.
Rydge did not provide any forecasts for the rest of the financial year.
Amalgamated Holdings reported a net profit of A$38.04 million for the year to June 30, 1996, from A$40.65 million in 1994/95.
